results.title: Jennie to return with new EP this month
results.description: Blackpink's Jennie is preparing to release a new EP in late August, her agency Odd Atelier said Wednesday. The upcoming release follows a string of appearances at major global music festivals this year. Jennie headlined the Governors Ball Music Festival in New York in June, followed by Roskilde Festival in Denmark, Open'er Festival in Poland and Mad Cool Festival in Spain in July.
